invites.title: Invites
invites.intro: Invite someone onto this server. Everyone you invite gets their own account — their own sign-in, their own mail.
invites.mintHint: You get a link that works once and expires in seven days. Send it to them, or let them scan it from your screen.
invites.mintedLead: Send this link to them — it works once and expires in seven days.
invites.mintedLeadFor: Send this link to {name} — it works once and expires in seven days.
invites.qrAria: Your invite link as a QR code. Scan it with a phone camera.
invites.copyFailed: The link couldn't be copied here — let them scan the code instead, or make a new invite.
invites.mintedOnce: The link is shown only this once. If it goes astray, revoke it below and make a new one.
invites.stepUpExpired: Your confirmation window has closed. Sign in again, then retry.

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: Put the ohmail app on another device and it reads this account's mail. Every signed-in device is listed here, and you can sign one out at any time.
devices.addHint: You get a QR code to scan from the ohmail app on the device. The code works once and expires in five minutes.
devices.mintedLead: In the ohmail app on the device, choose to scan a code and point the camera here.
devices.mintedLeadFor: In the ohmail app on {name}, choose to scan a code and point the camera here.
devices.qrAria: Your pairing link as a QR code. Scan it from the ohmail app on the device.
devices.typedEntry: No camera on the device? Type this link into the app instead:
devices.copyFailed: The link couldn't be copied here — scan the code instead, or type the link off the screen.
devices.mintedOnce: The code works once and expires in five minutes. It's shown only this once — if it goes astray, revoke it below.
devices.thisDevice: This browser — the one you're reading in now.
devices.removeWhat: It loses access with its next request. You can pair it again with a new code.
devices.stepUpExpired: Your confirmation window has closed. Sign in again, then retry.
devices.stepUpLead: Confirm it's you first. Verify your second factor and this continues right here — no need to sign in again.
devices.stepUpTotpLabel: Six-digit code from your authenticator app
devices.stepUpCodeHint: Each code works once. If you just signed in with a code, wait for your app to show the next one.
devices.stepUpLocked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
devices.stepUpBadCode: That code didn't work. Codes expire quickly — try the newest one.
devices.stepUpBadPasskey: That passkey wasn't accepted. Try again, or use another method.
devices.stepUpSlowed: Checks for this account are slowed after many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
devices.stepUpRefused: The check did not go through. Try again in a moment.
devices.stepUpCancelledNothingRan: Nothing ran. You cancelled before the check finished.
devices.stepUpRecoveryLabel: One of the recovery codes you saved
devices.stepUpBadRecoveryCode: That recovery code didn't work. Each code works once — try another one from your list.
devices.webGroup: {count, plural, one {# other web session} other {# other web sessions}}
devices.webGroupMeta: Browser sign-ins that aren't this one · last seen {seen}. Signing them out won't touch your paired devices.
devices.webGroupAsk: Sign out {count, plural, one {# web session} other {# web sessions}}?
devices.webGroupWhat: Each loses access with its next request. This browser and your paired devices stay signed in.
devices.webGroupDone: Signed out {count, plural, one {# web session} other {# web sessions}}.
devices.loadFailed: Your devices could not be loaded.

account.title: Delete your account
account.signOutBody: Ends this session and removes the mail cached in this browser. Your mailbox and your account are untouched.
account.signOutBlocked: Your session is ended, but the mail cached in this browser is still here: another ohmail tab is holding it open, or this browser refused to delete it. Close ohmail's other tabs and press Sign out again; if it keeps failing, clear this site's data in your browser settings.
account.signOutUnverified: ohmail could not confirm that the mail cached in this browser is gone: this browser will not say which local databases it holds. Your session is ended. Clear this site's data in your browser settings to be certain, or use a different browser to sign in here.
account.signOutServerRefused: The mail cached in this browser is removed, but the session could not be ended on the server: {reason} Your sign-in may still work until you try again — press Sign out once more, or revoke this device from the Devices list.
account.erasedMirrorBlocked: Your account is erased. The mail cached in this browser could not be removed, because another ohmail tab is holding it open — close ohmail's other tabs and reload this page.
account.eraseRefused: Your account was not deleted and nothing was removed. Start the confirmation again to retry.
account.eraseRefusedSubCancelled: Your account was not deleted. Your subscription was cancelled before the error; nothing else was removed. Start the confirmation again to delete the account.
account.eraseRefusedSubFailed: Your account was not deleted and nothing was removed. Your subscription may still be active. Start the confirmation again to retry.
account.eraseUnconfirmed: We could not confirm whether your account was deleted. Reload this page: if it asks you to sign in, the deletion went through.
account.eraseUnconfirmedSubCancelled: We could not confirm whether your account was deleted. Your subscription was cancelled. Reload this page: if it asks you to sign in, the deletion went through.
account.eraseUnconfirmedSubFailed: We could not confirm whether your account was deleted, and your subscription may still be active. Reload this page: if it asks you to sign in, the deletion went through.
account.mail: Your mail is on your own server, in the ohmail folders it is filed into. This deletes our copy; your mailbox stays exactly as organized as it is now.
account.gone2: Every mailbox you connected, and the stored credentials for it.
account.gone3: Every message, thread, contact and note we mirrored, with your rules, screener decisions and workflows.
account.gone4: Your passkeys, authenticator and recovery codes, and every session on every device.
account.goneWhen: One database transaction, immediately, and the copy in this browser is wiped too.
account.kept1: One billing row with a random id and no name, plus the credit ledger, the subscription record and the link to Stripe. Your address on it is overwritten. Financial records carry a retention obligation that Art. 17(3)(b) preserves. The record of what our staff looked at or changed on the account stays too, under the same id. Hashes of your sign-in tokens stay for up to 400 days after they expire, so an app still signed in is told the account is gone.
account.keptSelfHost: An account row with a random id and no name, and hashes of its sign-in tokens for up to 400 days after they expire, so an app that still holds one is told the account is gone.
account.keptSub: Your subscription is cancelled immediately as part of this. The days already paid for are not refunded.
account.backups: Backups expire on their own schedule.
account.factorBody: The next successful factor erases the account for {email}. There is no further step after it.
account.cancelledNothingErased: Nothing was erased. You cancelled before the check finished.
account.doneBody: It is gone from our live systems and you are signed out on every device. Your mailbox is untouched — open it in any mail app and the ohmail folders are still there.
account.doneSubFailed: We could not reach Stripe to cancel your subscription. Your account is erased, but the subscription may still be active — write to support@ohmail.app and we will cancel it.
account.signedOutBody: Deleting an account needs a live session on that account.
account.unavailableBody: This copy of ohmail has no server attached, so there is no account to delete.

passwordChange.title: Change your password
passwordChange.lead: Every other session, on every device, is signed out when it changes, and any sign-in still waiting to finish is cancelled. This one stays signed in.
passwordChange.needCurrent: Type your current password first. Nothing was changed.
passwordChange.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same. Nothing was changed.
passwordChange.tooShort: The new password needs at least 12 characters. Nothing was changed.
passwordChange.tooLong: The new password can have at most 256 characters. Nothing was changed.
passwordChange.same: The new password is the one you have now. Nothing was changed.
passwordChange.wrongCurrent: That is not your current password. Nothing was changed.
passwordChange.locked: Too many wrong passwords from this browser. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
passwordChange.slowed: Password checks for this account are slowed after many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
passwordChange.conflict: The password was changed from another session a moment ago, so this change was not made.
passwordChange.refused: The password was not changed. Try again in a moment.
passwordChange.done: Your password has been changed. {count, plural, =0 {No other session was signed in.} one {# other session was signed out.} other {# other sessions were signed out.}}
passwordChange.factorBody: The next successful factor changes the password. There is no further step after it.
passwordChange.cancelled: Nothing was changed. You cancelled before the check finished.

security.title: Security
security.intro: Your second factor and the codes that get you back in if you lose it.
security.stepUpExpired: Your confirmation window has closed. Sign in again, then retry.
security.codesHeld: You still hold unused recovery codes. Each one works once.
security.codesNone: You have no unused recovery codes. Without them, losing your authenticator locks you out.
security.codesReplaceWarning: This replaces every code you have. Any you saved before stop working.
security.codesShownOnce: Save these now. They are not shown again.
security.totpOn: An authenticator app is set up.
security.totpOff: No authenticator app is set up.
security.totpScan: Scan this in your authenticator, or type the key in by hand:

accountLifecycle.graceEnds: Your trial ended. ohmail keeps organizing until {date}.
accountLifecycle.paymentFailed: Your last payment failed. Fix it by {date} to keep ohmail organizing.
accountLifecycle.caughtUp: ohmail is catching up on mail that arrived since {date}.
